title: Persist applicant CV uploads and reject foreign CV paths
description: REQ-APPLY-CV-001: Fix candidate application submission so a selected PDF/DOCX is uploaded through the existing authenticated private CV endpoint and the returned storage_path is submitted instead of the browser filename. On the server, accept cv_url only when that path belongs to a cv_documents row owned by the authenticated candidate; preserve optional CV behavior, existing candidate role checks, Turnstile and application uniqueness behavior. Keep employer CV download authorization [REDACTED] of scope; no new RLS policy or database migration. Update the four locale CV size labels from 4 MB to the actual existing upload limit (10 MB). OpenCode is the sole implementation writer; Chief validates; Cline is read-only reviewer.
acceptanceCriteria: Selected CV is uploaded to /api/aday/cv before application POST; the submitted cvDosyaYolu is the server-returned storage_path, never the File.name; unauthenticated or failed upload does not create an application; server rejects unregistered/foreign candidate CV paths and accepts registered paths belonging to the current candidate; no-CV submission retains existing optional behavior; only PDF/DOCX files up to 10 MB are represented in all four locale labels; no new dependencies or schema migrations; type-check and lint pass; Cline review only after complete validation; no commit by OpenCode.
